Rails will not re-run this timestamped migration on already-migrated databases, so the change won’t apply there. While in most fresh installs the table won’t exist so `force: true` won’t change the resulting schema, modifying an already-run migration is a real maintenance concern and can lead to different outcomes in edge cases (e.g., if the table exists when migrating from scratch or migrations are re-run).
